title: State dependent bit transformation
statement: For an emitter state $q$ and a finite Boolean word $w$, process the bits of $w$ in order using the emitter state transition, starting in state $q$. At each step emit the input bit with its value complemented exactly when the current state is $k_2(0)$; the resulting word is the transformation of $w$.
